races.title: Midnite A Next Generation Betting App Handicap
races.verdict: MASEGO has made a positive start for Tony Carroll, beaten only by a new stablemate at Southwell on his latest outing, and he could be ready to get back to winning ways returned to this longer trip. He gets the vote ahead of Sea of Charm , who quickly bounced back to form last week, while Stitching Wheel is interesting on her stable debut. MASEGO (IRE) SEA OF CHARM (FR) STITCHING WHEEL (IRE)

Multiple C&D scorer Sir Rodneyredblood should be all the better for his reappearance last week and appeals as the chief threat ahead of Dashing Donkey and Solid Bond . races.verdict: BY JOVE GRACE showed improved form when a clear-cut winner of a Musselburgh maiden in September and, having not been seen to best effect on nursery debut last time, she is taken to double her tally. Dowman is feared most as he bids for a quick-fire hat-trick, ahead of Harry's Pop . BY JOVE GRACE (IRE) DOWMAN (IRE) HARRY'S POP

races.title: AWC Finals Day At Newcastle 26th March Fillies' Handicap
races.verdict: COXY'S STAR took her form up a notch to get off the mark at Wolverhampton last month and with better to come now up and running, she's fancied to shrug off a 3 lb rise and follow up. Forbidden Colours is unlikely to live up to her price tag/pedigree but should be making her mark in this, with Overbudget rounding off the shortlist. races.title: Darley EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict: An interesting novice with SPACE BOB selected to build on what was a very promising opening effort when second at Nottingham last month. Force of Light may also display above-average improvement on this second start, while Sexy is a very notable newcomer given her pedigree and sales price. SPACE BOB (IRE) FORCE OF LIGHT SEXY

races.title: AWC Season 14 Has Begun Handicap
races.verdict: A strong-looking race for the grade with BASED taken to double his career tally with the outside stall hopefully not a hindrance for one who is often dropped in. Honey Dale seeks a quick-fire hat-trick and will doubtless be popular, with Tam Lin perhaps the pick of 4 live chances for Mick Appleby. BASED (IRE) HONEY DALE (IRE) TAM LIN (IRE)
